name: Voltas Ltd
title: Voltas Ltd - 500575 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Voltas RAC channel inventory cut to under 45 days (near 30) and April ran close to record March, but UCP margin fell to ~3.2% in FY26 from 8.4% and management gave no hard margin number.

utilisation.quote: The Chennai and Pantnagar manufacturing facilities are currently operating at better utilization levels as compared to the previous year.

capex.quote: we plan to continue doing that

triggers.label: Channel inventory under 45 days
triggers.quote: the channel inventory has dropped dramatically. It's less than 45 days now, probably closer to 30 days

triggers.label: Blended price hike 6-7% plus 1-2%
triggers.quote: it was a blended 6%- 7% because it was 5 % for the 3-star

triggers.label: April near March record
triggers.quote: April also, we have almost done very close to that number

triggers.label: Margin recovery left unquantified
triggers.quote: We don't want to guess that number now

triggers.label: Chennai at 1.5m units, next capex deferred 1-2 yrs
triggers.quote: we will wait for another 1-2 years more before we do our next investment

guidance.value: gradual step-up towards FY25 levels, no number
guidance.quote: I think it will be a gradual step-up. As Sridhar was mentioning
this will certainly expect it to grow at least 15% to 20% is what we feel

red_flags.label: Unallocated costs up sharply, FX and treasury MTM
red_flags.quote: one of the reason is the forex impact and the mark-to-market from the treasury angle

red_flags.label: Inventory moderately elevated at Q4 end
red_flags.quote: Inventory levels during the quarter remained moderately elevated

evasions.quote: We don't want to guess that number now because many of the things like the dollar
we just want to sort of keep that as a goal rather than look at percentage gross margin is probably not driving us
